EFFECT: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Armoured Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Indomitable Defence
rules.description: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Linebreaker Onslaught
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. If this unit disembarked this turn, this unit can re-roll charge rolls and enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Damocles-class Uplink
enhancements.description: CAPTAIN model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a TRANSPORT unit, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that INFANTRY unit.

rules.name: Combined Deployment
rules.description: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
stratagems.effect: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

rules.name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
rules.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units' (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.
ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated, you can only select each combat doctrine once per battle. Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name. In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

armyRules.name: Space Marine Chapters
armyRules.description: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

armyRules.name: Shock Disembark Move
armyRules.description: Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if, as stated in the allowing rule, the unit is embarked within a TRANSPORT model on the battlefield and did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Effect: set up the unit as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. After moving: the unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

armyRules.name: Assault Disembark Move
armyRules.description: Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if, as stated in the allowing rule, the unit is embarked within a TRANSPORT model on the battlefield, did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase, and that TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase. Effect: set up the unit as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
